requirements.requirement: The system must render a visible pass or fail badge for each provider triage result.
The system must display the specialty match explanation directly beneath the pass/fail badge.
The system must render reasoning sections in the order provided by S2 logic with specialty reasoning appearing before quality reasoning.
The system must support expandable and collapsible reasoning sections for additional details.
The system must default reasoning sections to collapsed state except for the top (specialty) explanation.
The system must visually distinguish pass vs fail states using consistent color and icon patterns aligned with existing UI conventions.
The system must integrate triage UI components within the existing MessageBubble component without breaking current chat rendering.
The system must render multiple providers' triage components independently within a single chat response.
The system must handle missing specialty explanation by displaying a fallback message indicating unavailable data.
The system must handle empty reasoning arrays by rendering only the badge and a minimal explanation without UI errors.
The system must ensure all triage text content is safely rendered without executing embedded scripts or HTML.
The system must display LLM-generated specialty explanations in concise natural language not exceeding a predefined character limit.
The system must ensure LLM-generated explanations avoid medical claims beyond provided data and only reflect triage reasoning inputs.
The system must render LLM-generated reasoning sections with clear labels (e.g., 'Specialty Match', 'Quality Signals').
The system must ensure LLM-generated text is deterministic per input payload and does not vary across re-renders.
The system must truncate overly long LLM-generated reasoning with an option to expand for full visibility.
The system must ensure LLM-generated explanations are free of placeholder text or incomplete sentences before rendering.
The system must prevent duplicate reasoning sections from being displayed if repeated in the input.
